input:
We added an off-chip trace probe via TPIU (Trace Port Interface Unit) but trace data is corrupted. Trace probe captures bytes but the decoder fails to align frames.

TPIU configuration:
  TPIU_CSPSR = 0x10  (16-bit data port width)
  TPIU_SPPR = 0x00   (parallel mode)
  Trace probe sample rate: 200MHz
  ATB clock from SoC: 600MHz

Why does the probe sample rate mismatch with the ATB clock cause frame misalignment? What is the role of the formatter (FFCR) in interleaving ETM/STM/ITM trace, and how does enabling FFCR.EnFCont help vs hurt frame alignment?
